resources.string: These are local receipts for this recording. Verification means matching bytes were read back after the document was closed. It does not prove the file is still available or backed up by a cloud service.
No export attempt has been recorded for this recording. Earlier app versions did not save receipts.
Export history is unavailable. Its original database is retained. This does not mean there are no exports, and you can still make a verified recovery copy.
Document closed; verification was interrupted or not recorded
Written, but readback could not be verified
Recording export readback verified, but the local receipt could not be saved. Keep the external copy.
Local export receipts could not be removed; their database is retained. External documents are not deleted.
